info.title: Federal Register agencies (one operation, for the kit C gateway step)
info.description: A deliberately small description of one endpoint of the public Federal Register API. It uses only what AgentCore Gateway documents as supported for OpenAPI targets: OpenAPI 3.0, an operationId, one server URL, a GET with one simple path parameter and a JSON response.

get.summary: Look up one Federal Register agency by its slug.
get.description: Returns the agency's name, short name, description, parent agency id and child agency slugs. Use it to confirm an agency slug before searching documents by agency.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The agency slug in lower case with hyphens, for example commerce-department.
